steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The blessed tree... was defeated?
Following the annihilation of the furious Corruptors, the contamination of the High Tower Black Ring gradually disappears. Yanyan thanks you hastily before rushing to that branch.
That crystalline object previously hanging at the top of the High Tower now lies quietly on the ground.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: A dazzling blessed branch full of power... Is this the material for the bow described in the Ode to Sun? Great! Now that we have it, we can make the bow.
Examining the ominous dark crystal, the girl doesn't seem scared at all and even reaches out to touch it.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: Stop. That's a contaminant. Don't touch it directly!
The FAC soldiers nearby run over to stop Yanyan.
Yanyan looks at the FAC soldiers and tilts her head cluelessly, then with skillful hands produces a piece of cloth and wraps up the crystal.
The FAC soldiers breathe a sigh of relief at Yanyan's response, but still hope you can take her to an M-value test.
This crystal exudes a familiar aura. It's a distant memory. That Ash Crystal you found in WhiteSands.
Yanyan's actions have been rather naive and reckless this whole time, but you can indeed see the links to the myth. The tall Fusang tree, the magical branch...

You're not sure if the myth from the East is true, but after picking up this crystal, the people at the Drifter Camp do seem to be doing better. Inexplicably, you feel this proves the Sun Crow Apostle is disrupting DisCity in some way.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Thank you for helping me get the blessed branch, ${PlayerName}. Although it's not quite like what's described in the myth... Ugh, we ended up giving the Fusang tree a beating…
steps.female_content: Thank you for helping me get the blessed branch, ${PlayerName}. Although it's not quite like what's described in the myth... Ugh, we ended up giving the Fusang tree a beating...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is it really okay... We didn't do as the myth said, I'm afraid...
Yanyan frowns, seeming both glad and worried.
You pick up the myth book Yanyan accidentally dropped and return it to the girl.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Myths can have different interpretations. Maybe the hero made up that story to save face for the Fusang tree? Maybe our version is closer to what actually happened.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The most important thing is, the people nearby are no longer suffering. Everyone's headache is gone.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...That's right! How did Yanyan not think of that! What matters is that everyone's doing better now!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: If the Fusang tree was indeed in league with the monsters to bully everyone, then it deserves to be taught a lesson by the hero! You're exactly right, ${PlayerName}!
Yanyan takes the book from your hand and smiles like a blooming flower.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: What a great victory! The material we found this time seems even bigger than what Yanyan got back home. We'll definitely make the best bow ever!
Scene change to Drifter Camp

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Hey! You're back? You look like you've just been in a fight. Are you exhausted?
Hearing the familiar voice, Yanyan stops in her tracks.
It's Greta, and he's followed by quite a few people. It seems that after getting rid of their headaches, everyone has come here to get some essence oil from the doctor to help relax their muscles.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Emmm? Even though you do the wrong ritual dance, you can still cure everyone's headaches?

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Hehe. This is new to you, isn't it? This is <size=50>yooga</size>!
Greta finally seizes the chance to clear up the confusion.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: He's right. It's not a ritual dance.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Though it's not the Eastian ritual dance, it still helps everyone stay strong and healthy and even inspired many people in West District during the great disaster.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...It inspired many people in West District?
You look at Greta. Just like back then, he's putting those people who just got rid of their headaches in funny poses.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: West District has gone through some tough times before, during which everyone was cooped up underground. Not only did their bodies become sluggish, but their mood also worsened.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But Greta didn't give up. When many were in despair, he was the one who led everyone to do yooga every day.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: He wanted to help everyone get in shape, and also to cheer them up by fooling around.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Oh my. You flatter me too much, Chief.
Greta flashes you a big smile. It seems he quite enjoys the compliments.
Yanyan looks toward the rubble they passed by earlier, then to the bustling crowd on the street, and lowers her head slightly.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I... I didn't mean to criticize his dance...
She lifts her head, her eyes sparkling.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: We perform the ritual dance... to pray for blessings...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: So that everyone can still keep a smile in the face of disaster...
Though a bit shy, Yanyan still gives Greta a proper bow.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Although... your Sun Crow ritual dance was not up to standard, anyone who can bring a smile to people's faces has the gift to become a great seer!

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Oh~~~ my, and I'm sure you've got that gift as well, Yanyan. Hehe. Wanna come and practice yooga together? There aren't many diligent girls like you in the whole Drifter Camp.
Greta scratches the back of his head and grins.
Yanyan and Greta keep on chatting. Yanyan even performs another part of the Sun Crow ritual dance in front of the crowd.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Yes! Bravo!
The crowd keeps on applauding, cheering even louder than before.

steps.speaker: Pedestrian A
steps.content: Wasn't there a little girl named OwO who kept talking about the East? Too bad she went off to make a movie.

steps.speaker: Pedestrian B
steps.content: Right! No wonder it felt so familiar!

steps.speaker: Pedestrian C
steps.content: Exactly! It's a bit confusing at first, but it becomes fascinating once you get used to the style! Look, doesn't that move just now look like OwO's lion dance?

steps.speaker: Pedestrian B
steps.content: Yes, I can see it!

steps.speaker: Pedestrian C
steps.content: Check this out, hey!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Wow! These moves are pretty awesome too. Why don't you join Yanyan? We could use a few more companions. Let's explore the Sun Crow's myth together!
The crowd disperses all of a sudden. The folks at the Drifter Camp have been traumatized by the force of Mania. They flee the moment they hear about this kind of mission.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hey! Wait! I won't force you to learn everything all at once! You can take your time!
It seems a long myth-exploring journey still lies ahead of Yanyan.
